title: $232,140 a Year to Fly Planes
description:
Airline pilots make 232,140 dollars a year. That's the median.

Sources:
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Airline pilots, copilots, and flight engineers 53-2011, annual median wage, May 2025: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000053201113
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Airline pilots, copilots, and flight engineers, 10th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000053201111
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Airline pilots, copilots, and flight engineers, 90th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000053201115
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Airline pilots, copilots, and flight engineers, employment: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000053201101

BLS May 2025 (OEWS), airline pilots, copilots, and flight engineers (53-2011): 103,560 jobs on payrolls (OEWS does not count the self-employed); median $232,140; 10th percentile $106,710; 90th percentile $463,830. Median = half earn more, half earn less. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Airline pilots make 232,140 dollars a year. That's the median.
And the top ten percent? Over 463,000 a year.
Even the low end is high. Only one in ten earn under 106,710.
But it's a small club. Just 103,560 jobs in the whole US.
So the full range? About 107,000 up to 463,000.
